newsitem.title: INDONESIA: JAKARTA STOCKS END SHARPLY DOWN ON RUPIAH FLOAT.
newsitem.headline: JAKARTA STOCKS END SHARPLY DOWN ON RUPIAH FLOAT.

text.p: Jakarta stocks ended sharply down on Thursday following an announcement by the central bank that it was scrapping its intervention band, effectively floating the rupiah currency.
Stocks fell across the board on the move and a subsequent plunge in the rupiah, although brokers said finance and banking stocks were particularly badly hit.
The Jakarta composite index closed down 15.59 points, or 2.37 percent, at 643.01 points. Decliners led advancers by 137 to 19 with 27 unchanged.
